newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lafarge, CECF form China investment JV.
newsitem.headline: Lafarge, CECF form China investment JV.

text.p: Lafarge Group said on Friday it signed a joint venture agreement with Citcorp Everbright China Fund (CECF) to identify investment opportunities and invest in the cement and building materials industries in China.
The joint venture holding company will have an initial authorized capital of US$150 million, which is later expected to rise to US$300 million, Lafarge said in a statement.

Existing investments of the two parties, who have been co-investing in the cement industry in China since 1994, will be consolidated and transferred to the new company, subject to the necessary approvals by the Chinese authorities.
These investments include Chinefarge Cement, and a ready mix concrete plant in Beijing, in which Lafarge, a world leader in building materials, has the majority stake.
